title: Record changed
description: A record file under the specs folder was saved, added or removed, by a person in an editor or by an agent, which the server announces as `spec:changed`.

title: Product extension changed
description: A kinds, relations, sections or IDs file of the meta-model, or a product's extension of it, was edited, which the server announces as `spec:changed`.

title: Check changed
description: A check's SQL file was added, edited or removed, among Lathe's checks or a product's own, which the server announces as `spec:changed`.

title: Workspace checked
description: The engine loaded a product's records and ran every check over them, for `lathe check`, for code that loads the workspace or for `GET /api/spec`.

title: Page opened
description: The reader went to an address in the app, by a link, a command, the address bar or the back button, which opens its page with the views it names.

title: Theme chosen
description: The reader kept a theme from the Color theme command or the Appearance page, which applies at once and is kept for them.

title: Color mode chosen
description: The reader chose Light, Dark or System, which decides which of every theme's two color sets shows.

title: Theme made
description: The reader made a theme of their own, by duplicating a theme or importing a theme file, which they can then edit.

title: Product window opened
description: The reader opened a product folder, from the Open dialog, Open Recent, the Dock or at launch, and it opened in a window of its own.

title: Product window closed
description: A product window closed, by the reader or because the shell quit, with its size and place saved for the next time.
